description:
**Phase E — prequel for E5a. Deps: B6 (opi-ixp.10), E0a (opi-ixp.45).**

Add `OctoPi.Coder.Session.build_session_context/1` — a `GenServer.call` that delegates to `SessionManager.build_session_context/2` with the held in-memory `SessionManager` (current branch leaf inferred internally, matching the `nil`/`:default` shape supported by B6).

Returns the same shape as the underlying call: `%{messages: [...], thinking_level: ..., model: ...}`.

Pure read-only addition. No state mutation; no extension dispatch. Used by E5a (opi-ixp.24) so the run-process can read the post-compaction message list directly without going through `Agent.Session`.

Tests: GenServer test verifying delegation — append a CompactionEntry via `Session.add_entry/3`, assert the returned messages reflect the kept window with the synthetic summary at the head.
title: E5a-pre². Coder.Session.build_session_context/1 GenServer call
